title: Liquidsoap goes RESTful
abstract: I will present the RadioZ automation system and review its liquidsoap script, focusing on HTTP endpoints. Because we don't see enough HTTP endpoints implemented in Liquidsoap.

title: Using CMS for listener auth & stats enrichment
abstract: Using Joomla as an example, how to use its user mechanisms, 'pay to play', audio players & features to allow/block listening to streams on a user, group and or time/date basis. Easily modified for Wordpress and probably many other CMS. Should work with Icecast2, Icecast-KH and Rocket Streaming Audio Server

title: Using liquidsoap for cultural community radio: Alicia radio
abstract: The "Multiforo Cultural Alicia" is an independet cultural forum. Music, literature, dance, movies, theatre and different cultural expressions have an space in this "underground culture laboratory". Since last year, besides its new site, it has a community internet radio station, "Alicia radio", broadcasting some of the music and art recordings made during a 30 year history. The radio is still growing, at this moment we are plannig the next steps, Alicia radio is an extension of he cultural effort made by this space, willing to get beyond Mexico city with the help of the internet radio. The whole radio is made possible by using liquidsoap.

title: Echo Radio, waking up to your favorite breakfast show
abstract: I am an Englishman living in San Francisco, and I miss my local radio. I can stream them online, but it's always in the timezone of the source. For years I want to replay these streams in my local time zone and after finding Liquidsoap, I could do just that! I started with a simple script and then ended up wrapping the whole thing with a Python Flask app and publishing as a Docker image so others can benefit.
